summary: Meiwu Technology filed a 6-K reporting results of a September 14, 2026 EGM, where holders approved a share capital reclassification into Class A and Class B ordinary shares, the repurchase of 135,000 Class A shares from Mr. Changbin Xia and 73 from Union International Company Limited, and adoption of amended articles granting each Class B share 150 votes. Turnout was 22,523,926 votes, or 85.54% of 26,330,471 shares outstanding as of the August 10, 2026 record date. The structure consolidates insider voting power via a dual-class recapitalization rather than a third-party transaction; watch governance and dilution risk.
